name: create_node_group_by
description: Builds a generic groupBy (key -> array of items, order preserved) consumed by an existing sizes helper
prompts: An existing stats.js requires groupBy from a group module and uses it, but group.js does not exist yet. Create group.js exporting groupBy(items, keyOf): it returns a plain object mapping each key produced by keyOf(item) to an array of the items that produced that key, preserving the original input order within each group. keyOf is a function from item to a string key. An empty items array returns an empty object {}. Every item must be placed in exactly one group (no items dropped, none duplicated). Do not modify stats.js. Export with module.exports = { groupBy }.
